postal_system.code_system: no-normal-postcode in existing QA address policy and reviewed addressing references
postal_system.inwani: Keep zone, street and building identifiers as distinct, source-qualified string components; a zone or road is not a postcode.
postal_system.po_box: Nonspatial postal-service identifier, never a geographic catchment, residence or occupant.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Administrative or census polygons remain administrative/statistical; roads remain polylines. No official postal surface is invented from containment, geocoding, interpolation, Voronoi or AGID cells.
postal_system.address_rule: QARS candidate field names and match scores do not verify a current assigned address. Exact civic context needs permitted explicit source relations and validity.
postal_system.building_rule: A source-qualified building number is not a footprint. Display a building only with independently permitted source data and an explicit stable address-building relation.
postal_system.crs_rule: Reviewed road/QARS metadata advertises WKID 2932, not WGS84. Require verified source CRS, datum, axes and transformation before spatial output.
postal_system.rights_rule: NPC June 2026 CC-BY-4.0 applies to classified C0 open data; it is not automatic permission for every GIS endpoint. Preserve positive CC-BY-4.0 grants for reviewed C0 census datasets, but do not misclassify their grain.
postal_system.privacy_rule: No QID, subscribers, recipients, phones, contacts, occupants, owners, tracking, query history or land-rights records. Never infer identity by joining public data.
postal_system.freshness_rule: Source data edition/validity differs from retrieval time, server version and modification time. Sparse LAST_UPDATE dates cannot establish current coverage.
postal_system.territory_rule: Preserve QA identity and exact source coverage; no boundary or sovereignty inference.

stages.definition: Reviewed country-specific authority/rights contract and reproducible public reference/aggregate checks.

A current, complete-for-declared-coverage, rights-cleared official Qatar Inwani civic-address dataset provides explicit zone/street/building identifiers and source-supplied georeferencing with stable source relations. Pin publisher, scope, edition, valid-time, retrieval time, SHA-256, artifact-specific C0/open-licence applicability or permission, attribution and third-party rights, CRS/datum/axis order and uncertainty. Reproducibly transform and validate uniqueness, missingness, identifier joins, geometry and coverage; publish approved immutable digest-pinned artifacts and verify the actual QA AGID loader/API. Use postal_code=null and official_postal_geometry=none unless a separate authoritative postal assignment and surface is proven. P.O. boxes, administrative zones, roads and generic geocoder Postal fields never manufacture postcodes or postal polygons. Building display requires a permitted explicit civic-address relation; building footprints require their own source and identifier join, not proximity, interpolation, containment or an unverified geocoder candidate. Policy documents, service schemas, counts, census aggregates and synthetic tests alone cannot satisfy M2.
Rights-cleared current building footprints and separately proven stable civic-address joins, with ambiguity and temporal validation.

hard_blockers: No current complete-for-declared-coverage rights-cleared Inwani address artifact has been obtained.
QARS and road services have no verified artifact-specific C0/open licence or permission and no confirmed data edition.
Census aggregates, road counts, generic candidate fields and public viewer access cannot replace actual address/building relations.
No approved immutable normalized data release or real QA AGID descriptor/API has been verified.

agid_integration.current_scope: QA UI already separates zone/street/building inputs and has no postcode field. Catalog now treats these references as metadata, not strong postal validation. No QA production Postal Context pack is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Actual permitted immutable address data and QA loader/API validation, not a metadata/synthetic test.
